reviews.t: This is ridiculous. Pathetically obvious that the same person ...
reviews.x: This is ridiculous. Pathetically obvious that the same person is behind all of the positive reviews. This is why I will not be purchasing. Turned off.

reviews.t: No 5-star reviews are from verified buyers
reviews.x: Interesting that, out of 76 5-star reviews, NOT ONE was from a verified buyer.  I was going to try these but not when the positive reviews are such flagrant lies.

They are pretty, but they had white near the magnets where the glue stuck to the packaging.  I just painted the spots with liquid eyeliner, so it's fine.  I like them because I've never been able to wear lashes but these are easy.

Firstly, these came stuck with glue to a glittery sticky paper so I had to pull them all off. These are not the best look and are only half lash and look very dramatic. They may be good for a night of clubbing, or super glam, but not for every day use as they look fake.
They stay put very well. The size is wrong, only fits the outter half of the lashes.  You could put 2 sets together to cover the whole lash but they don’t lay well.
Not happy with these at all. They only cover half of my eyelid. I’ll be returning them.

reviews.t: Doesn't replace a strip lash - doesn't follow lash line
reviews.x: If you are used to using a strip lash you understand that there must be curvature for the lash to properly follow your lash line. These go on "straight" so they do not curve to your eye/lash line. Also the magnet of one popped of when I was trying to use it so now they don't work but they were no good anyway. If you are not used to doing make up this might work for you for one night but if you are good at your make up and know what you're doing this product will just not be what you are

reviews.t: Cool concept, but not as easy as it looks
reviews.x: I looked through a lot of magnetic eyelashes, and these seemed to be the best reviewed for the best price. The packaging was in good shape when I got them, but it took me forever to figure out how to put them on  PROS: - the double magnets on each end make it so neither of the ends flare out -they are short so you can place them at the outer edge of your lashes to make them look more natural -they are tapered which gives them an even more natural look -they are not as cheap looking as some of th
Not what I expected, it was 8 half eyelashes. Very disappointed.

Received these today and the container they are in was all scratched and damaged on the outside. It was also not in a plastic protective sleeve similar to other brands I have purchased in the past. Decided to see what the product was like and it was clear they had been used/removed prior to them being purchased by me. The magnets are all on one side of the lashes, so they wouldn’t work correctly anyway.

reviews.t: Great idea but hard to apply
reviews.x: Looked great and I loved the concept but I could not (for the life of me) put them on. It wasn’t lining up correctly and tweezers couldn’t help either. I am not the lost savy person with cosmetics and have never worn lashes with the glue so maybe I’m just inexperienced. They were awesome but I returned them since I had no use

reviews.t: Came in a pretty, glittery storage case
reviews.x: Came in a pretty, glittery storage case, but lashes are too short to cover length of eye, and they look cheap. Not sure if user is supposed to trim lash length to desired look. Magnets seem like they don’t line up well. Not confident that the magnets will stay together to reliably keep lashes on for long periods of time.

reviews.t: These only go about halfway and so it looks funny if you have sparce inner lashes like me
reviews.x: Would give them a five star rating but... I wish that they would make these cover all along the eyelid. These only go about halfway and so it looks funny if you have sparce inner lashes like me. They last a while, but you will probably have to purchase another set if you plan to use them daily.

The magnets are on the top side of the lashes (both left and right). The way they are curled means that when you put them together (in the way the magnets require), they are going opposite directions and not even close to normal eyelashes.

reviews.t: Whoever wrote a good review for these was paid to
reviews.x: Whoever wrote a good review for these was paid to! They come with no instructions and are tiny, cheap quality and don’t work!
Love the concept, but I had difficulty shaping them to match the curve of my eye. Maybe not the best for rounder eyes.
They begin to fall off if your eyes water.

Sorry, but this product is a joke.  Package has NO writing on it not in any language so you have to figure out which lashes go on top and which go on bottom.  If you get it wrong, well magnets are magnets.  Practice first, you will ruin a pair but its worth it.  The top and bottom are the same fullness so once on (joke) you look like you have an animal on your eyelid.  The magnetic strip is after all, metal so it is only on each end and is rigid. Trying to bend it to the curve of your eye makes

I got this and thought it was nicely packaged and looked cute in the little container it came in. It’s definitely a little more complicated to use but gets easier as you practice more. Just doesn’t look that good on the lashes once on. You could see the magnets and it looked kinda funny if you looked close. It only covered one half of my eye so it looked full on one side but empty on the other. It was also hard to tell which one was suppose to go on the left and right eye. It’s good if you’re a

I don't like these but I am not going to give up on magnetic lashes! I purchased these before they had this many low ratings.  I think these suffer from having the magnets on the outside of the lash pieces. They are really hard to position even after patiently giving it my best for a while. They also slip and slide around my lashes. Also, the packaging! They stick them to the case with tacky tape stuff that made them a bit difficult to remove.

reviews.t: I cannot get these things to work properly. I ...
reviews.x: I cannot get these things to work properly.  I have tried and tried and they just don't look right.  They don't seem to be wide enough to really mix with my lashes.  Even if I could get them on properly (which I can't), they make one narrow section of lashes significantly longer.

reviews.t: Terrible! Have to be fake reviews
reviews.x: How amazing it would be if these worked! Number one problem is the lashes curl the wrong way.  The top curls down and the bottom curls up. Soooooo if you can even apply them,they look like a venus fly trap.  I’ll revisit once they’ve been on the market for awhile

Don't waste your money.  The product packaging (like a compact) is flimsy.  I would have returned it but my cat pushed it off the vanity and it shattered.  The lash length are so exaggerated that even if I managed to put it on, it will look ridiculously fake.

reviews.t: I got the type that only cover the outside of ...
reviews.x: I got the type that only cover the outside of your eyelids and they were square cut so I had to trim them to be tapered.  They were very difficult to apply.  Then I got them mixed up so that the magnets repelled each other.  They ended up in the trash.

reviews.t: Do not stay in place do not look natural.
reviews.x: They suck.  To small to look natural and its basically IMPOSSIBLE to get them on.  Then if you can get them on to stay they work themselves off because of the blinking! Never Again.  I should have known that it was to good to be true.

claims.text: Many reviewers suspect the positive reviews are fake or paid, which deterred some from buying.
A common complaint is that the lashes are too short and only cover half the eyelid.
Several reviewers find the lashes hard to apply and the magnets don't line up or stay together well.
Some reviewers say the lashes look good and stay put well once applied.
Some reviewers report poor quality, including glue residue on arrival and damaged or used packaging.
